_comment: MMFDB Admin, native emtk window: the panels that are not entity tables, one 'panel' per destination of the rail, each drawn by emtk.view_form over its model in gui/native/ (panels.py, spectra.py, provenance.py). A custom section names what gui/app.py draws itself: 'spectrum_plot' (the Spectra panel's plot), 'component_form' (the selected component's read-only form, the type's own optical_components/*.view.json) and 'provenance_graph' (the read-only node graph).
